none: PAS CAM-628517: Roman Coin: Nummus of The House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of The House of Valentinian. AD364-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend is GLORIA ROMANORVM. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding standard. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Diademed bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.6g, diameter is 16mm
